messages:
Anna (AE): hey team – kicking off the Catalyst pilot intake thread. Customer wants a 2-week technical pilot to validate LLM summarization + Q&A over their docs. I pulled their intake form into the shared sheet: https://tiny.redwood/catalyst-intake
Ben (SE): thanks — quick Q: do they have sample prompts or eval sets? we should lock those before we spin up infra.
Catalyst POC (customer): we can share 20 representative queries and 50 doc snippets by EOD tomorrow. priority is accuracy and hallucination rate < 5%.
Maria (Security): noted. ask: will any PII be included in the sample docs? also need to know their preferred data residency (US/EU) and whether they'll sign our standard DPA.
Anna (AE): they said no PII in samples, but production may include hashed IDs. they're OK with US-only. I'll follow up on DPA.
Devon (Product): success criteria draft: (1) F1/ROUGE target for summaries, (2) hallucination <5%, (3) median gen latency < 300ms for 512-token window, (4) cost per 1k tokens < $0.40 — want to validate these with customer.
Ben (SE): for latency/cost we should propose two configs: hosted Redwood with quantized model vs Dedicated with n1 GPUs. I'll put preliminary perf/cost numbers in the sheet.
Kevin (Infra): also need to confirm traffic shape (QPS, burst) and if they need VPC/private deployment. if they want private, timeline shifts ~2 weeks.
Catalyst POC (customer): expected steady QPS ~0.5–1, peaks up to 5/min. we prefer hosted for the pilot.
Maria (Security): i'll prep a short checklist: encryption at rest/in transit, access control, audit logs, and the SOC2 excerpt. can you share the security questionnaire PDF?
Anna (AE): uploading secq and sales SOW draft to the sheet now. link -> tiny.redwood/catalyst-docs (in sheet).
Ben (SE): action items: 1) SE to draft eval harness & example prompts (Ben) — due 3/29. 2) Security checklist + SSO/SCIM asks (Maria) — due 3/30. 3) Infra config + cost options (Kevin) — due 3/30. 4) Customer to provide samples (Catalyst) — ETA tomorrow. 5) AE to confirm DPA and sign-off on timeline (Anna) — due 3/29.
Devon (Product): one more ask — can we add a small A/B: quantized vs fp16 to measure quality drop? two-model comparison will help recommend production path.
Ben (SE): good call. i'll include the A/B plan in the eval harness.
Anna (AE): final: propose kickoff meeting with customer + SE + security on Tue 3/31 10am PT. who can join?
Ben (SE): I can.
Maria (Security): I can join the first half to run through the questionnaire.
Kevin (Infra): available but might need to join last 15 for infra decisions.
Catalyst POC (customer): 3/31 10am PT works for us. looking forward — we'll post the sample bundle tonight. :thumbsup:
Anna (AE): great — i'll send calendar invite and attach the intake sheet. thanks everyone!
